sources.scope: Opt-in fingerprints; earliest structural divergence only; same organization/workspace, limited retention; null ambiguous unless request context known; unavailable or pending inconclusive; Messages API, not Managed Agents. Not actor attribution or physical cache identity.
Authenticated generation metadata. Need actual prior and current generation, request preferences, and applicable policy to attribute a loss.

sources.facts: Vendor experiment 150 pinned requests, 79 Crusoe 429 attempts followed by CoreWeave success, all 150 returned 200; no measured cache loss in reported experiment.
sources.scope: Independent documented example of successful fallback obscuring prior failed attempt at HTTP status level.
Internal _routing removed before normal client response; explicit admin pin disables fallback; weighted selection and affinity may select alternate without failed attempt.
Operator log, not public trace or necessarily customer-facing; upstream cost optional.

Public release request schema: normalized block_ids, model, anonymous provider, cache_read_tokens, step_trigger, transition, cause; cause pertains to input mutation, not routing decision or legal fault. No failed_attempts, requested route preference, historical price, balance, or actual credit decision.

distinctions: Observed structural divergence != identity of the actor causing it.
Observed serving route change != failed fallback, forced switch, or causal cache loss.
Recorded failed attempt != fault attributable to platform under a contract.
Reference cost difference != actual charge or credit entitlement.
No direct confirmation of contractual fault from released trace; absence of evidence is not evidence of no fault.

restricted_reference_exposure.eligible_if: Hypothetical policy covers these selected severe switches only, positive difference and followup
restricted_reference_exposure.scope: Set of possible reference exposure conditional on stipulated eligibility; not a bound on actual damages, fault, or all platform events.
